blurb: Kent Point Marina offers boat slips to commercial crabbers and watermen, fishing and bait supplies, a rental boat, and a private beach-front rental house. They sell live and steamed crabs seasonally, fresh fish and seafood by pre-order year-round, and frozen seafood daily year-round. The Bait House store also offers snacks, drinks, marina gear, ice, propane, and gifts.
